messages.name: Support team
messages.text: Hello Olivia! Thanks for contacting support. How can we help today?

messages.name: Olivia Martin
messages.text: My inverter app has stopped showing live production data.

messages.name: Support team
messages.text: I can help you troubleshoot this. Could you confirm whether the inverter status light is green?

messages.name: Noah Williams
messages.text: I purchased a new system and need help registering the warranty.

messages.name: Support team
messages.text: Absolutely. Please share your product serial number and installation date.

messages.name: Emma Johnson
messages.text: I wanted to check when the installation team will arrive.

messages.name: Support team
messages.text: Your installation is confirmed for Thursday between 9 AM and 12 PM.

messages.name: Liam Brown
messages.text: Where can I find the installation guide for my product?

messages.name: Support team
messages.text: You can find product manuals in the Downloads section of our support website.
